title: Open a dedicated owner-authorized read-only Incident Detail from Command Work Queue
goal: Deliver one genuinely navigable, dedicated Class-0 Incident Detail HTML slice for an already authorized Command Incident, including off-page deep links and independently owner-authorized coordination source fields/Cases. Explicitly partial: no edit, mutations, Action Request, Incident Detail full acceptance or production IAM.
invariants: No object access via an ID alone: Project enumerates and CanRead-authorizes current <=5000 same tenant/env objects and then finds the exact requested Incident using existing FocusSelection, preserving off-page deep link behavior.
Read-only Incident Detail never issues a mutation, Case creation, Govern Action Request, export, new permission, or new source/trust assertion.

Use exactly the SAME selected-sources permission logic as Work Queue; factoring it into a helper preserves optional independently authorized factors/SLA/canonical ownership/linked Cases and fail-closed error behavior.
A Command Incident reader cannot infer any linked Case or Investigate timeline it lacks rights to read. Navigating to Case always requires a new independently authorized request.
A disclosed Incident's source freshness/status and missing fields remain truthful; no invented title, risk, next action, dedup or response decision.
Strict GET-only, one query key, HTML-only, no user-selected principal/tenant/env; no raw source ID, secret or credential in href.
All canonical product specs, #208 reviewed SHA and base PRs remain immutable; child branch created from exact #208 head.
security_properties: Host session resolution and Owner.CanRead every read; revoked/missing/off-tenant incidents uniformly return 404 without content or identifiers.
Optional factor, SLA, canonical registry and Case link adapters are each independently source-authorized and validated before HTML is emitted.
html/template auto-escapes all owner data; CSP prohibits scripts/forms/frames, no-store/no-referrer/nosniff; browser re-resolves scope upon return/navigation.
No production provider trust, CSRF/TLS deployment, durable audit, source data collection or conditional mutation is claimed.

migration.rationale: Read-only UI and optional same-origin routing; no database or source schema change.

rollback.strategy: Revert dedicated incident_detail handler, selected_context extraction, one link and optional host route; original Work Queue/Case routes remain.
verification: Existing Work Queue JSON and HTML tests remain unchanged
Old two-handler host NewHandler constructor remains valid

inputs: CAP-CMD-106 Incident Coordination §17,§25 and screen CMD-IWQ-006 §3,§7,§15,§22/26
CAP-CMD-101 Work Queue selection and existing owner-authorized source facets
E10-CMD-106I-DEEPRETURN IMPLEMENTED on source #208; separate L2 still pending at branch creation, not automatically accepted
outputs: Dedicated `GET /command/incident-detail?incident=...` HTML read-only page in existing local command-investigate-host with authorized owner/state/freshness/source factors/SLA/linked Investigate Cases.
A new selected Incident detail link from existing Work Queue screen, and a return link using freshly authorized Command Work Queue deep selection.
One shared `enrichSelectedResult` owner read implementation for original Work Queue and new Incident Detail, not a duplicated authorization engine.
Reproducible Go HTTP and real localhost browser navigation tests including off-page success and revocation/denial.
acceptance_tests: A previously authorized Incident beyond first queue page opens its own HTML detail after every current in-scope owner ACL has been re-evaluated.
Revoked or nonexistent ID fails generic 404 with no Incident/Case details; malformed/foreign/unexpected query rejected before session or owner.
Original Work Queue selection and JSON response semantics unchanged, including optional factors/SLA/linked sources.
Local synthetic analyst follows Work Queue→Incident Detail→Case Timeline→authorized return; Command-only principal reads permitted Incident but not linked Case.
GET-only/HTML-only, no form or script; response headers cache/CSP/Referrer safe, zero credential in URL.
Relevant Go tests/race/vet/CI and unchanged engineering mandatory checks pass on EXACT PR HEAD; separate L2 required before acceptance.
definition_of_ready: Source #208 E10-CMD-106I-DEEPRETURN is IMPLEMENTED with exact-SHA CI 4/4 green but pending independent L2/merge
Existing Work Queue first-party Project+source owners and Command Investigate host exist and are verified at source SHA
Only Class-0 bounded read-only Incident Detail is included; OPEN-013 mutation remains blocked
definition_of_done: Real local analyst can open a dedicated Incident detail and return without gaining linked Case rights
Exact head CI and risk-based L2 are published; approved merges and production remain separate obligations
No new third-party runtime dependency or weakened access gate

performance_budget.rationale: One fresh bounded <=5000 Work Queue authorization pass and one existing selected-source owner projection; no additional source engine. No production SLO.
